unbound_context_only_primary_observation.locator: Final journal text, PDF pp.2–4 / printed pp.79–81, Methods 2.1–2.5; DOI 10.1016/j.chemgeo.2016.09.038
unbound_context_only_primary_observation.summary: Independent web-tool full-text read confirms Rietveld identification, no minor phases detected by XRD/SEM, K0.75Na0.22Fe0.01Al0.98Si3.02O8 composition, hydrothermal chemistry and interruption times. Same-study corroboration, not replication. This reviewer did not acquire local journal PDF bytes or assert complete journal graphic/supplement equivalence.
limitations: Assessment covers the full relevant Chapter XII, not all unrelated chapters of the 274-page thesis.
The chapter and final journal are the same study. Final journal methods text was read, but local final journal PDF/image and any supplemental equivalence are not asserted.
One interrupted run is not replicated reactors; fifty pits describe within-surface observations.
A polished Na-bearing natural crystal and one hydrothermal face/condition do not establish all-feldspar behavior; initial surface rounding and polishing defects affect model interpretation.
No microbial potassium release, recovered product, constituent criticality or industrial deployment is inferred.
The bounded notice/conflict searches do not establish exhaustive later-literature coverage.
unbound_context_only_primary_observation.disposition: Web-text context only; no local artifact/hash or complete journal graphics/supplement verification is asserted. Accepted experimental evidence binds the full thesis separately.
